Welcome to the first official release of Gleam 🥳

We finally made it out of the digital lab without setting anything on fire. If you have ever stepped out into the blazing midday sun only to realize your phone screen turned into an expensive pocket mirror, this app is built for you.

Instead of fighting your OS slider or swiping down five times while squinting like a confused pirate 🙂, Gleam reads your ambient light sensor and kicks your screen backlight into overdrive the second sunlight hits it. When you head back indoors or lock your phone, it calmly restores your preferred brightness. No drama, no battery crying in the corner.

### The Problem We Solved
Digging through system menus or fighting lazy adaptive brightness algorithms is annoying. Gleam puts instant sunlight boost right on your phone with zero delay, zero background bloat, and 100% on-device privacy.

### What is Packed in v1.0.0
- **Sunlight Auto-Boost:** Detects outdoor lux spikes and pushes brightness to maximum instantly 😎.
- **Physical Sensor Tracking:** Real-time hardware light sensor reads with zero background polling or battery drain.
- **Tactile Porcelain Dial:** A physical spring-loaded control dial that feels genuinely satisfying to drag around.
- **Screen-Off Restore Profiles:** Choose whether to return to your previous level, a custom floor, or the last auto reading.
- **Home Screen Widget:** 1-tap boost toggle so you do not even have to open the app.
- **Quick Settings Tile & Shortcuts:** One swipe from your notification shade or launcher.
- **100% Offline & Private:** Zero internet permissions, zero trackers, and zero telemetry. Your data stays strictly on your device 🤩.

### APK Variants Provided
- **Universal:** Works on all Android devices (recommended if you are unsure).
- **arm64-v8a:** Optimized for modern 64-bit Android smartphones.
- **armeabi-v7a:** For older 32-bit Android hardware.
- **x86_64:** For Android emulators and ChromeOS tablets.

Here is to never having to cup your hand over your screen on a sunny street again 🫡. Enjoy the sunshine!
